links.outcome: Readability of chatbot kyphosis answers versus AMA-recommended sixth-grade reading level
links.effect: All six chatbots wrote above the sixth-grade level, and no significant readability differences were found among them (FKGL, FKRS, SMOG, ARI, GFOG). Outputs were hard for average patients to understand.
links.quote: All chatbots presented content at a readability level higher than the AMA-recommended sixth-grade level.

screen.reason: Evaluated the readability, quality, and reliability of six LLM chatbots responding to patient queries regarding kyphosis without testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
